card.name: Scattered words in non-drug prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words in general web prose, such as 'number' after 'square', 'says' after a quote, or a name starting a sentence.

modes.label: Square-number arithmetic

modes.label: Speech verb after quote
modes.description: The verb 'says' right after a closing quotation, before a speaker's name.
modes.example: in the whole solar system,"<< says>> Orton. The top of the storm

modes.label: Sentence-start subject
modes.description: A subject word such as 'we' or a name opening a new sentence in a narrative passage.
modes.example: Today<< we>> have the computers. On the other hand
